title: The New Covenant Inaugurated: John
subtitle: John 1-21
theme: The Word became flesh. Union with Christ, eternal life, and the Spirit’s coming.
memoryText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
reviewQuestions: What does the Prologue teach about the identity of Jesus?
What do the seven “I AM” statements reveal about who Jesus is?
What does the Upper Room Discourse teach about the Holy Spirit?
What does “abiding in the vine” look like in everyday Christian life?
psalmsNote: Light (36, 43), the shepherd (23), and God’s nearness (139, 100, 103) beside John.
